content.title: How you can watch the Cardinals in 2026
content.text: Skip to contentST. LOUIS, Mo. (Matrix Midwest) - This week, the Cardinals released more information on how fans can watch the team during the 2026 season.Fans can watch the Redbirds all season on Cardinals.TV (except for games on national TV). The cable and satellite providers that will carry the games were announced this week, along with the channels: Charter / Spectrum (Digital) – 362Charter / Spectrum (Set-Top Box) – 233 (Evansville, IN 535)DirecTV / DTV Stream – 672AT&T U-verse - 1746FuboComcast / Xfinity - 126110 regular-season Cardinals games will also be simulcast on First Alert 4 (KMOV-TV) and Matrix Midwest. One-hour replays of 130 games will air on Matrix Midwest all season long! Click here for the complete schedule of St. Louis Cardinals, Memphis Redbirds, Springfield Cardinals and condensed games that will air in 2026 on Matrix Midwest!You can find Matrix Midwest over-the-air on channel 32 and on Spectrum channel 6.Copyright 2026 Matrix Midwest.
